data.name: Parminder
data.long_meaning: Parminder is a name derived from the Sanskrit language. It is a compound name where 'Parm' means supreme or universal and 'inder' means lord or master. Hence, Parminder translates to 'Lord of the World'. In Hindu mythology, this name is associated with Lord Shiva, who is regarded as the supreme god and ruler of the universe.
